brand.name: Oya
brand.tagline: The AI agent for everyday life
brand.mission: AI has lived on the internet, serving people who work online. Oya brings it into everyday life.
brand.positioning: Starting in Nigeria, built for everywhere.
brand.promise: Say what you need. Oya sorts it, from start to finish.

scope.rule: Oya is an agent for every part of daily life. Never present it as a marketplace, shopping app or delivery service.
jobTypes: Know: power supply, prices, fuel availability, local alerts, exam and school dates
Get things done: government paperwork, admissions, applications, renewals
Book: services, appointments, travel, outings, events
Find: jobs, homes, places, people who can help
Remember and plan: reminders, household admin, multi-step missions like moving city
Get help: emergencies, repairs, health facilities
Buy and pay: one job type among many, not the headline
scope.language: Talk about needs, requests and people who help, not sellers and orders. Show a mix of job types in every hero, demo and example set, with at least half involving no purchase.

forest.role: Primary dark. Hero and closing backgrounds, headings on light, primary text.

cream.role: Primary light background. Text on dark.

sand.role: Second light background, used to alternate sections. Muted card fills.

paper.role: Card surface on cream or sand.

orange.role: Brand accent. Primary buttons, wordmark, statement backgrounds, icon fills, eyebrows on dark. Never as text on light.

ember.role: Orange for text on light backgrounds: eyebrows, numbers, labels.

leaf.role: Secondary accent. Success states, icon fills, large numbers, charts.

deepLeaf.role: Green for text on light backgrounds: 'You get' labels, positive figures, links.

mint.role: Soft fill: icon tiles, user chat bubbles, highlight rows.

peach.role: Soft fill: alternate icon tiles, badges.

muted.role: Footnotes, captions, placeholders. Use at 24px or larger on cream (4.43:1).

hairline.role: Card borders, dividers, timeline rails on light.

forestLine.role: Dividers and dashed rings on forest.

forestEdge.role: Outline buttons and pills on forest.

stone.role: Neutral chart colour, inactive states, cost bars.

chatBg.role: Chat screen background in phone mockups.

contrast.note: WCAG ratios measured on the brand hexes. Normal text needs 4.5:1; large text (24px+, or 18.66px+ bold) and graphics need 3:1.

pairs.use: fills and graphics only, never text
any text: buttons and statement sections

display.name: Bricolage Grotesque
display.use: Headlines, big numbers, card titles, the wordmark.

body.name: DM Sans
body.use: Body copy, UI, buttons, tables, eyebrows.

accent.name: Caveat
accent.use: One handwritten aside per page at most, never body text.

scale.note: slidePx is what the decks use on a 1920×1080 canvas. web is the recommended responsive equivalent.

rules: Eyebrows sit above every section headline: ember on light, orange on forest.
Emphasise with weight or colour, never a new size.
Body text columns stay between 55 and 75 characters wide.

statement.heading: forest
statement.use: Once per page: the one sentence people should remember.

radius.iconTile: 28% of tile size (34 on a 120 grid)

elevation.rule: Most surfaces use a 1px hairline border instead of a shadow. Shadows are for device mockups and one hero element.

chatAction.use: Action buttons inside chat: Choose, Confirm, Book, Remind me, Get directions, Pay

recommendationCard.border: 1px solid hairline; best match gets 3px solid orange plus a peach 'Best match' badge

timelineRail.node: 72px circle: orange, leaf, deepLeaf, forest in sequence

iconography.style: Custom illustrated icons on a 120×120 grid.
iconography.uiIcons: For small UI icons use a rounded line set (Lucide or Phosphor) at 2px stroke in forest, or forest on an orange circle chip.

imagery.primary: Illustration and product mockups (phone chat, web app panels), not stock photos.
imagery.photography: If used later: real people going about everyday life (at home, on the road, at work, in school, out with family), warm natural light, never staged office scenes.
imagery.signatureGraphic: The hub: Oya's orange chat orb at the centre, everyday-need icons on a dashed orbit ring, on forest.

patterns: Chat bubbles arrive one by one with a short rise and fade.
'Watch it work' status lines tick in as the agent checks, asks, books and confirms on the user's behalf.

do: Use short, concrete sentences about real errands.
Let Pidgin appear in product moments and sign-offs ('Oya. Sort am.', 'Rider don pick am').
Say what Oya does, not how clever the AI is.
dont: Never promise what the agent can't guarantee; the 'Sorted' guarantee is the promise.

rules: Never use pure #FFFFFF or #000000; use paper/cream and forest.
Orange is a fill, not a text colour on light backgrounds; use ember for orange text.
One orange statement section per page.
At most one gradient per page, and only if it earns its place.
Colour never carries meaning alone: pair status colours with words.
Two background tones (cream and sand) plus forest for hero and close.
